import { requestAccount } from '../js/auth.js'; const form = document.getElementById('signup-form'); const submitBtn = document.getElementById('submit-btn'); const statusMsg = document.getElementById('status-msg'); function showStatus(message, type) { statusMsg.textContent = message; statusMsg.className = `status-msg show ${type}`; } function setLoading(loading) { if (loading) { submitBtn.disabled = true; submitBtn.innerHTML = ' Submitting…'; } else { submitBtn.disabled = false; submitBtn.textContent = 'Request Account'; } } form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); statusMsg.className = 'status-msg'; // hide previous const fullName = document.getElementById('full-name').value.trim(); const department = document.getElementById('department').value; // Client-side validation if (!fullName) { showStatus('Please enter your full name.', 'error'); document.getElementById('full-name').focus(); return; } if (!department) { showStatus('Please select your department.', 'error'); document.getElementById('department').focus(); return; } setLoading(true); try { await requestAccount(fullName, department); form.reset(); showStatus( 'Your request has been submitted. Your credentials will be sent to you once approved.', 'success' ); } catch (err) { showStatus(err.message || 'An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.', 'error'); } finally { setLoading(false); } });
